zh.name: 艾莲
zh.desc: 认真敷衍，准时迟到，今天也是被闹钟击败的打工少女！\n即使在异世界也要写假期作业，身为旅行团的保镖却时常站着睡觉——\n但请千万别惹她，除了慵懒的尾巴，她还有锋利的鲨牙。

1.name: 情绪整装待发
1.desc: 艾莲回合开始时恢复<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】，艾莲施放【冰海潜游式】时，本次【冰海潜游式】造成的所有伤害无视目标 <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>的防御力。若本次【冰海潜游式】消耗了6点【咬合力】，本次攻击结束后艾莲<u>行动提前</u><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。

10000001.name: 行动提前
10000001.desc: 使目标在下次行动前的等待间隔缩短。

2.name: 对镜子捏出笑脸
2.desc: 艾莲施放【冰海潜游式】后，【鲨牙布】立即施放一次<u>追加攻击</u>。【鲨牙布】每次施放攻击时使艾莲恢复<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点能量与<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】，并使艾莲下一次【冰海潜游式】造成的所有伤害的暴击伤害提高<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>，该效果不可叠加。

10000004.name: 追加攻击
10000004.desc: 满足条件时自动触发的效果，对目标施放1次额外的攻击。

3.name: 清晨是糖果味的
3.desc: 战技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级。

4.name: 总之，将爱心奉上
4.desc: 艾莲施放【冰海潜游式】时，本次【冰海潜游式】造成的所有伤害的冰属性<u>抗性穿透</u>提高 <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。

30000005.name: 抗性穿透
30000005.desc: 当造成伤害时，无视敌方目标的一部分对应伤害属性的抗性值。

5.name: 放学后，游入海洋
5.desc: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过<unbreak>10</unbreak>级。

6.name: 吃饱睡饱免打扰
6.desc: 艾莲施放【冰海潜游式】时，本次【冰海潜游式】造成的所有伤害冰属性<u>抗性穿透</u>提高<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>，对敌方随机单体目标造成伤害的次数增加<unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>次。艾莲施放终结技后，获得<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>层【狂宴时刻】，【狂宴时刻】的持有上限为<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层。持有【狂宴时刻】时，艾莲回合结束或【零号连线】结束后，立即消耗1层【狂宴时刻】，艾莲获得1个可插入施放终结技的<u>额外回合</u>，并回复<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点咬合力。

10000000.name: 额外回合
10000000.desc: 获得1个不消耗回合数的额外回合，在此回合中无法插入施放终结技。

30000005.name: 抗性穿透
30000005.desc: 当造成伤害时，无视敌方目标的一部分对应伤害属性的抗性值。

151401.name: 利齿修剪法
151401.desc: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害。
151401.simple_desc: 对指定敌方单体造成少量冰属性伤害。

151402.name: 暴风雪特调
151402.desc: 获得<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】。使指定敌方单体陷入【咬痕】状态，受到的普攻伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>，随后对该目标造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害，同时对相邻目标造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害。我方目标回合开始或行动时，若场上不存在陷入【咬痕】状态的敌方目标，艾莲使当前生命值最高的敌方目标陷入【咬痕】状态。
151402.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>获得<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>点【咬合力】</color>。使敌方单体陷入【咬痕】状态，<color=#f29e38ff>受到的普攻伤害提高</color>。对敌方单体造成冰属性伤害，对相邻目标造成少量冰属性伤害。

151403.name: 欢迎来到冰河纪
151403.desc: 对敌方全体造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害。并对处于【咬痕】状态的敌方目标额外造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害。
151403.simple_desc: 对敌方全体造成大量冰属性伤害并对处于【咬痕】状态的敌方目标额外造成大量冰属性伤害。

151404.name: 邦布帮帮
151404.desc: 战斗开始时召唤【鲨牙布】，【鲨牙布】初始拥有<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点速度。【鲨牙布】行动时发起<u>追加攻击</u>，对敌方单体造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害，【鲨牙布】会优先攻击陷入【咬痕】状态的目标。\n 艾莲拥有6点【咬合力】上限，我方角色施放普攻、战技、终结技进行攻击时，使艾莲获得<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】。\n【冰海潜游式】无法触发【邦布帮帮】的效果获得【咬合力】。
151404.simple_desc: 战斗开始时召唤【鲨牙布】，【鲨牙布】优先对陷入【咬痕】状态的目标发动攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害。我方角色施放<color=#f29e38ff>普攻、战技、终结技</color>进行攻击时，使艾莲<color=#f29e38ff>获得<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>点【咬合力】</color>。\n【冰海潜游式】无法触发【邦布帮帮】的效果获得【咬合力】。

10000004.name: 追加攻击
10000004.desc: 满足条件时自动触发的效果，对目标施放1次额外的攻击。

151405.name: 零号连线
151405.desc:
队伍中包含<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>时：
艾莲施放终结技后，解除<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>的<u>控制类负面状态</u>，随后自动施放1次【冰海潜游式】，再立即触发<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>的【共舞，跃动轻音】，随后使<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>获得1个可插入施放终结技的<u>额外回合</u>。
<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>施放终结技后，解除<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>的<u>控制类负面状态</u>，随后自动施放1次【高歌，倾落华彩】，再立即触发艾莲的【利齿修剪法】，本次【利齿修剪法】使艾莲获得1点【咬合力】，该次攻击结束后，再触发1次艾莲的【冰海潜游式】。
由【零号连线】触发的攻击在选择主目标时，均优先选择陷入【咬痕】状态的敌方目标。
由【零号连线】触发的普攻均不恢复战技点，由【零号连线】触发的【冰海潜游式】均不消耗【咬合力】，并额外对随机敌方单体造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害，优先选择本次【冰海潜游式】的主目标及其相邻目标，共弹射<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>次。
151405.simple_desc: 队伍中包含<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>时，<color=#f29e38ff>任一方施放终结技后</color>，解除对方的<u>控制类负面状态</u>，随后触发<color=#f29e38ff>多次攻击</color>。<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>施放终结技后，艾莲自动施放<color=#f29e38ff>强化普攻</color>。\n<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>施放终结技后，<unbreak>耀嘉音</unbreak>在这些攻击结束后获得1个可插入施放终结技的<u>额外回合</u>。

10000000.name: 额外回合
10000000.desc: 获得1个不消耗回合数的额外回合，在此回合中无法插入施放终结技。

10000011.name: 控制类负面状态
10000011.desc: 冻结，纠缠，禁锢，支配，怒噪，强烈震荡，异梦，缠禁，恐惧，行动锁定，幸福傀儡，怨火灼身，麻痹。

151406.name: 攻击
151406.desc: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

151407.name: 狩猎巡游
151407.desc: 使用秘技后进入持续<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>秒的【巡游】状态。【巡游】状态下会快速向前移动，在快速移动的过程中可抵挡敌人的所有攻击。【巡游】状态下施放攻击或停止移动可以提前结束持续时间，主动攻击敌人进入战斗后，使自身获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】并恢复<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点能量，并对敌方全体造成等同于艾莲<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>攻击力的冰属性伤害。
151407.simple_desc: 使用秘技后进入【巡游】状态快速向前移动，【巡游】状态下主动攻击敌人进入战斗后，使自身<color=#f29e38ff>获得<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>点【咬合力】并恢复能量</color>，并对敌方全体造成少量冰属性伤害。

151408.name: 冰海潜游式
151408.desc: 消耗所有【咬合力】，使主目标陷入【咬痕】状态并对其造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害，对相邻目标造成等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害。\n激活条件：当【咬合力】大于等于3时激活【冰海潜游式】，消耗的【咬合力】大于3时，每额外消耗1个【咬合力】，则对随机敌方单体造成1次等同于艾莲<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的冰属性伤害，优先选择本次【冰海潜游式】的主目标及其相邻目标。\n此次攻击不恢复战技点。
151408.simple_desc: 消耗所有【咬合力】，对指定敌方单体造成<color=#f29e38ff>大量冰属性伤害</color>，对相邻目标造成冰属性伤害。消耗的【咬合力】大于3时，每额外消耗1个【咬合力】，就对敌方随机单体造成1次冰属性伤害。

1.point_desc: 每有1名除艾莲以外的我方目标为艾莲提供至少1个仍在生效的增益效果，艾莲的暴击伤害提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>，最多计入2名我方目标。计入2名我方目标时，艾莲造成的伤害额外提高<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>。
战斗开始时，艾莲获得<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】。当【咬合力】达到上限后，艾莲每额外获得 1 点【咬合力】，使艾莲行动提前 <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>，该效果艾莲每回合可触发<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>次，艾莲自身回合结束时重置该次数。
【鲨牙布】攻击目标后，艾莲获得<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点【咬合力】，该效果每次【鲨牙布】行动最多触发1次。

en.name: Ellen
en.desc: Diligently slacking off, punctually late... Today is just another day of this working gal getting defeated by her alarm clock!\nDespite having to do holiday homework even in another world, and frequently falling asleep standing up despite being the tour group's bodyguard...\nBut please, whatever you do, don't mess with her. Aside from that languid tail, she's also got razor-sharp shark teeth.

1.name: Moods Packed and Ready
1.desc: When Ellen's turn begins, recovers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Shark's Gotta Bite." When Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," all DMG dealt by this use of "Ice Sea Diving" to ignore <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF. If this use of "Ice Sea Diving" consumes 6 points of "Shark's Gotta Bite," Ellen's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> after this attack ends.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

2.name: Pinch a Smile at the Mirror
2.desc: After Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," "Sharkboo" immediately uses a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>. When using each attack, "Sharkboo" regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy and recovers <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Shark's Gotta Bite" for Ellen, and increases all CRIT DMG dealt by her next "Ice Sea Diving" by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. This effect does not stack.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

3.name: The Morning Melts Sweet
3.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

4.name: A Heart Served All the Same
4.desc: When Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," increases the Ice <u>RES PEN</u> of all DMG dealt by this use of "Ice Sea Diving" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

5.name: The Ocean Swims Her Home
5.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

6.name: Fed, Rested, and Left Alone
6.desc: When Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," all DMG dealt by this use of "Ice Sea Diving" has its Ice <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>, and the number of instances of DMG dealt to random single enemy targets increases by <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>. After Ellen uses her Ultimate, she gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Revelry Instant." The max limit of "Revelry Instant" stacks is <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>. While possessing "Revelry Instant," after Ellen's turn or "Zoned In on Zero" ends, 1 stack of "Revelry Instant" is immediately consumed, and Ellen gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> during which she can use her Ultimate, and regenerates <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Shark's Gotta Bite."

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

151401.name: Saw Teeth Trimming
151401.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to one designated enemy.
151401.simple_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated enemy target.

151402.name: Blizzard du Jour
151402.desc: Gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Shark's Gotta Bite." Inflicts the "Bite Mark" state on one designated enemy target, increasing the Basic ATK DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to that target, while simultaneously dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to adjacent targets. At the start of an ally target's turn or when they take action, if there are no enemy targets in the "Bite Mark" state, Ellen causes the enemy target with the highest current HP to become afflicted with "Bite Mark."
151402.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Shark's Gotta Bite."</color> Inflicts the "Bite Mark" state on one enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>increasing the Basic ATK DMG taken</color>. Deals Ice DMG to one enemy and minor Ice DMG to adjacent targets.

151403.name: Welcome to the Ice Age
151403.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to enemy targets in the "Bite Mark" state.
151403.simple_desc: Deals massive Ice DMG to all enemies and additionally deals massive Ice DMG to enemy targets in the "Bite Mark" state.

151404.name: Better Call Bangboo
151404.desc: At the start of the battle, summons "Sharkboo" with an initial SPD of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. When "Sharkboo" takes action, it launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to one enemy. "Sharkboo" will prioritize attacking targets in the "Bite Mark" state.\nEllen has a "Shark's Gotta Bite" limit of 6. When an ally character uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack, Ellen gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Shark's Gotta Bite."\n"Ice Sea Diving" cannot trigger the effects of "Better Call Bangboo" to gain "Shark's Gotta Bite."
151404.simple_desc: At the start of combat, summons "Sharkboo." "Sharkboo" prioritizes attacking targets in the "Bite Mark" state, dealing massive Ice DMG. When an ally character attacks with a <color=#f29e38ff>Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate</color>, Ellen <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Shark's Gotta Bite."</color>\n"Ice Sea Diving" cannot trigger the effects of "Better Call Bangboo" to gain "Shark's Gotta Bite."

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

151405.name: Zoned In on Zero
151405.desc:
When <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak> is in the team:
After Ellen uses her Ultimate, it dispels <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak>'s <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, and she automatically uses "Ice Sea Diving" 1 time, then immediately triggers <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak>'s "Minuet Pianissimo," and grants <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak> 1 <u>extra turn</u> that can be used to insert an Ultimate.
After <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak> uses her Ultimate, it dispels <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak>'s <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, and she automatically uses "Cadenza Cascade" 1 time, and immediately triggers Ellen's "Saw Teeth Trimming." This instance of "Saw Teeth Trimming" grants Ellen 1 "Shark's Gotta Bite," and after this attack ends, triggers Ellen's "Ice Sea Diving" 1 more time.
When attacks triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" select a primary target, they prioritize enemy targets afflicted with the "Bite Mark" state.
Basic ATKs triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" do not recover Skill Points, "Ice Sea Diving" triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" does not consume "Shark's Gotta Bite." Additionally deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to one random enemy, prioritizing the primary target of this use of "Ice Sea Diving" and its adjacent targets, bouncing <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) in total.
151405.simple_desc: When <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak> is in the team, <color=#f29e38ff>after Ellen or Astra Yao uses their Ultimate</color>, they dispel <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from the other, then trigger <color=#f29e38ff>multiple attacks</color>. After <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak> uses her Ultimate, Ellen automatically uses <color=#f29e38ff>Enhanced Basic ATK</color>.\nAfter <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> uses her Ultimate, <unbreak>Astra Yao</unbreak> gains 1 <u>Extra Turn</u> after those attacks end, in which she can use her Ultimate.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze, Paralysis.

151406.name: Attack
151406.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces the enemy target's Toughness of the corresponding Type.

151407.name: Roaming Hunt
151407.desc: Using the Technique grants the "Roaming" state for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. While in the "Roaming" state, this unit moves forward rapidly, blocking all enemy attacks while moving. Using an attack or stopping while in the "Roaming" state ends it prematurely. After actively attacking an enemy and entering combat, this unit gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Shark's Gotta Bite," regenerates <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy, and deals Ice DMG equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of Ellen's ATK to all enemies.
151407.simple_desc: After using Technique, enters the "Roaming" state and moves forward rapidly. After entering combat by actively attacking enemies while in the "Roaming" state, this unit <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> "Shark's Gotta Bite," regenerates Energy</color>, and deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies.

151408.name: Ice Sea Diving
151408.desc: Consumes all "Shark's Gotta Bite," inflicting the "Bite Mark" state on the primary target and dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to it. Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to adjacent targets.\nActivation Condition: "Ice Sea Diving" activates when "Shark's Gotta Bite" is 3 or higher. If the "Shark's Gotta Bite" consumed exceeds 3, each additional "Shark's Gotta Bite" consumed deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ellen's ATK to one random enemy, prioritizing the primary target of this "Ice Sea Diving" and its adjacent targets.\nThis attack does not recover Skill Points.
151408.simple_desc: Consumes all "Shark's Gotta Bite" to deal <color=#f29e38ff>massive Ice DMG</color> to one designated enemy and Ice DMG to adjacent targets. When the consumed "Shark's Gotta Bite" exceeds 3, for each extra "Shark's Gotta Bite" consumed, deals 1 instance of Ice DMG to one random enemy.

1.point_desc: For every ally target other than Ellen that provides Ellen with at least 1 active buff, Ellen's CRIT DMG increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, up to a max of 2 ally targets taken into account. When 2 ally targets are taken into account, DMG dealt by Ellen additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

At the start of the battle, Ellen gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Shark's Gotta Bite." After "Shark's Gotta Bite" reaches its max limit, every 1 excess point of "Shark's Gotta Bite" Ellen gains advances her action by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can trigger <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s) per Ellen's turn, and this trigger count resets when Ellen's turn ends.
After "Sharkboo" attacks a target, Ellen gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point of "Shark's Gotta Bite." This effect can trigger at most once per "Sharkboo" action.
